verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a SaaS registrar that holds customer data and ships AI features (AI Domain Search, MCP), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has no policy or control for excluding user data from AI model training. WHOIS privacy and the security features are adjacent privacy controls, not an AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
